CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

   A. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
